source_summary: Tall monochrome ink landscape with mist-filled mountains above a layered river plain and foreground groves. Red seals and calligraphy are present but excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: misty_left_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant cliff group at the upper left of the painted landscape: one tall vertical slab-like cliff on the far left and a softer rounded peak just to its right, both fading into blank mist.
must_preserve: small rounded peak with faint ink pooling

motifs.name: large_left_mountain_mass
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant dark mountain mass left of center, rising from fog with a rounded summit and broad sloping shoulders.
must_preserve: dark clustered texture strokes along crest
vertical wash streaks descending the face
soft lower edge dissolving into mist
subtle darker ridge line on the right slope

motifs.name: central_sharp_peak_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the central group of steep, narrow peaks: the tall dark triangular foreground peak with adjacent smaller spires and pale recessive ridges behind it.

motifs.name: right_receding_mountains
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side receding mountain range, including several pale steep peaks and the broad rounded mountain at the far right.
must_preserve: feathered lower slopes fading into blank paper

motifs.name: central_mist_cloud_band
motifs.description: Isolate the horizontal mist and low cloud band below the mountains, with irregular soft-edged ink pools and blank channels suggesting water or vapor.
must_preserve: blank negative spaces between cloud forms
low horizontal drift across the composition
slightly darker pooled ink at center

motifs.name: left_foreground_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense grove at lower left with clustered dark foliage, thin trunks, and layered low banks around it.
must_preserve: varied ink density from black accents to pale wash

motifs.name: middle_river_plain_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the middle river plain with open pale water or sand bands, small tree groups, and low horizontal embankments across the center.
must_preserve: small clustered trees with thin trunks

motifs.name: right_foreground_pavilion_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right foreground hillside containing a small pavilion or hut under a dense tree grove, with sloping bank and surrounding shrubs.
must_preserve: small angular roof with simple linear eaves
dense dark foliage canopy above and beside pavilion
slender tree trunks and branch strokes
sloped foreground bank with parallel dry-brush texture

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
